title: perityle gracilis
intro: Perityle gracilis, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. As a medicinal plant, Perityle gracilis is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve skin health, and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Perityle gracilis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and act as a natural anti-histamine. The bioactive constituents of Perityle gracilis include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
